annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1978 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for the use of DEHP, BBP, DBP and DIBP in spare parts recovered from and used for the repair or refurbishment of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1978 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for the use of DEHP, BBP, DBP and DIBP in spare parts recovered from and used for the repair or refurbishment of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L 402/65)
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Directive adding an exemption (entry 47) to RoHS Annex IV, allowing certain phthalates in recovered spare parts used to repair or refurbish medical devices, within auditable closed-loop B2B systems with customer notification, expiring 21 July 2028. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds entry 47 to Annex IV of RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU
Exempts DEHP, BBP, DBP, DIBP in recovered spare parts for medical device repair/refurbishment
Reuse must occur in auditable closed-loop B2B return systems with customer notification
Member States must transpose by 30 April 2022, applying retroactively from 21 July 2021
